# Turned Away, Said Plainly

Version 3.2.3 says plainly when bergfex refuses Home Assistant, takes new snow from the right resort, judges opening hours on Austrian time and asks bergfex for less.

## bergfex blocks Home Assistant

Since 17 November 2026, Cloudflare in front of bergfex answers requests from Home Assistant with `403 Forbidden` on all bergfex domains. On many connections, existing entries stop updating and new resorts cannot be added. Nothing in your setup causes this, and switching the language does not help. **This release does not lift the block.** Only bergfex can do that, and the integration will not try to get around it. Status and details are in _[#57]_.

- **The setup dialog names the refusal.** When bergfex refused the resort list, the dialog said that no ski areas were found and that there might be no current snow reports, which sent people looking for missing reports. It now says that bergfex refused the request, and the Home Assistant log has the Cloudflare ray id. A missing page or a page without the resort list still shows "no ski areas found". _[#88]_
- **The README warns about the block.** A note at the top explains the block and points to [SnowSure](https://github.com/timmaurice/snowsure) as an alternative. SnowSure is a separate integration with its own entities, not a drop-in replacement. _[#89]_

## Resort data

- **New snow comes from the resort itself.** The new snow figure is copied from the region snow report. A resort whose path is part of a neighbour's path could get the neighbour's figure: Ehrwalder Alm showed the 30 cm of Ehrwald Wettersteinbahnen instead of its own 2 cm. The region report is now matched to the exact resort. _[#87]_
- **Open or closed follows Austrian time.** The status compared the opening hours with the clock of the Home Assistant host. On a host running on UTC, such as a plain Docker install, a resort stayed open an hour too long and opened an hour late. The hours are now checked on Vienna time, like the timestamps bergfex prints. _[#87]_
- **The resort's main page is fetched once a day.** Price, opening hours and the season panel come from the resort's main page, which was fetched again on every poll, so each poll cost two requests per resort. These values are now kept for 24 hours, and a failed fetch keeps the last values and tries again on the next poll. _[#87]_

## Fixes

- The forecast carousel in the card no longer throws an error when forecast images disappear while you look at a later day. It moves to the last day still available. _[#87]_

## Upgrading

Nothing to change after updating. Reload the page once so the browser picks up the new card. While the block lasts, updating does not bring bergfex data back on connections that are refused.
